title: UPSC Engineering Services Mains Result 2026
vacancyDetails: Written result of ESE/IES Main 2026; qualified candidates shortlisted for Interview / Personality Test (approx. 1,341 candidates as per reports)
qualification: Engineering degree as per UPSC ESE rules for Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Telecommunication streams
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years (as on crucial date; relaxations as per UPSC ESE rules)
applicationFee: As per ESE 2026 notification (exemptions for Female/SC/ST/PwBD as applicable)
selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination → Main (Written) Examination → Personality Test / Interview → Final merit
documentsRequired: Roll number, DOB, e-Summon letter (for interview), original certificates for age, qualification, category, PwBD (if any)
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.upsc.gov.in
2. Open Written Result: Engineering Services (Main) Examination, 2026
3. Download roll-wise / name-wise PDF
4. Search your roll number (Ctrl+F)
5. If qualified, update DAF / documents in the 15-day window and watch for e-Summon for Personality Test
shortDescription: UPSC ESE/IES Mains Result 2026 declared on 24 July 2026. Written result PDF for Engineering Services Main (21 June 2026) at upsc.gov.in; next stage Interview.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has declared the Engineering Services (Main) Examination, 2026 Written Result on 24 July 2026.

The Main written examination was held on 21 June 2026. Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF have been provisionally shortlisted for the Interview / Personality Test.

Key Points

  • Result available as PDF (roll-wise and name-wise) on upsc.gov.in
  • Candidature is provisional pending document verification
  • Qualified candidates get a window (about 15 days) to update details and upload proof of qualifying examination on the UPSC portal
  • Interview dates will be intimated via e-Summon from upsc.gov.in / upsconline.nic.in
  • Marksheets for all candidates are usually uploaded after the final result

How to Check

  1. Visit https://www.upsc.gov.in
  2. Click Written Result: Engineering Services (Main) Examination, 2026
  3. Download PDF and search your roll number / name

Official PDF (name list example path): upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/NameList-WR-ESEM-26-Engl-240726.pdf
